status: Qualification comparisons, not a new adopted training recipe.

observation_results.limitation: Engineering and matched causal effects only; not proof of cortical realism, readable latent information or pretraining transfer.

protocol: Same native input/noise, initial condition, maps, carrier and recording settings within each pair. Rank term removed on the right. Source global normalization and each24s frontend fit recomputed by the unchanged renderer. Two plotted basis coordinates are fixed construction axes, not fitted PCA. Native input displayed at32Hz from its128Hz sample-and-hold; state is sampled after integration. Independent real recordings are not time-aligned to these simulations.
